tbesh_html:
§ Tahpanhes or Tahapanes or Tehaphnehes = "thou will fill hands with pity"
a city in Egypt; modern 'Tel Defenneh' or 'Tel Defneh' located approx 18 miles (29 km) east southeast from Tanis

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Tachpanches, Techaphneches or Tachpenes, a place in Egypt
strongs_1890.derivation: or תְּחַפְנְחֵס; (Ezekiel 30:18), or תַּחְפְּנֵס; (Jeremiah 2:16), of Egyptian derivation;
